items.title: GID Intercepts 81 Suspected Migrants, Arrests Two Alleged Traffickers in Separate Operations
items.summary: By Makutu Manneh The Gambia Immigration Department (GID) has intercepted 81 suspected would-be migrants and arrested two alleged migrant traffickers in separate operations in Brufut and Kuntaya Village, as authorities intensify efforts to combat irregular migration. In a state...
